The vehicle is excellent and really helps with getting around what can be a confusing Orlando with all the theme parks. Spacious, smooth, and clean cyber truck was perfect for getting all around what would normally be stressful parking lots, parking structures, and directions. Added bonus if you have kids: the drives to the theme parks is almost as exciting as the rides.

⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐We absolutely loved Bandit! My whole family enjoyed this Tesla, and it made our Orlando vacation even better. The self-driving capability is incredible, the ride is unbelievably smooth, and the seats are so comfortable. It was honestly one of the most enjoyable cars I’ve ever driven! The host was fantastic! Super friendly, helpful, and easy to communicate with throughout the entire trip. You can tell she really cares about making sure her guests have a great experience. The only thing I’d recommend is allowing some extra time for drop-off, since airport parking can be a little tricky. I should have planned a bit more time for that myself. Other than that, everything was wonderful! We had such a great experience, and my family was sad to give Bandit back. I would absolutely rent this Tesla again and highly recommend it to anyone visiting Orlando. Thank you for such a great experience!
Cleanest car we have rented on turo. Host was easy to contact. Had no issues. Would highly recommend

Literally the most top-of-the-line Tesla currently sold, with FREE FSD, and a FREE mobile charger (so you can plug into a standard outlet in the garage)! Both things I usually have to explicitly ask for, and usually have to pay for, just here by default. The host was very communicative, and pickup was easy. The car was very clean, I even got some “Nice car!” shouts while in the parking lot. If this is your first time driving a Tesla, this is the one to get.
The magic battery car brought me over 1000 miles through 5 states with maybe 3 miles of myself driving. It was transformational.

Then it was dark and raining and the car was parked all the way in row 20 which took forever to locate on foot with a heavy suitcase. After a long day of travel, I didn’t want to spend an extra 45 minutes trying to find the car. Then, I had to pay $14 to leave the parking lot.

Had an awesome experience renting from Naree! Communication was super fast from start to finish, which made everything so easy. We covered over 2,600 miles all the way to Texas with zero major interventions. The only time we actually took over was to park in a better spot! If you want a trip with an amazing car, you're in good hands booking with Naree.

Naree was a fantastic host! The 2026 Tesla Performance Model Y (Bandit) was top-of-the-line, immaculately clean inside and out, and offered at an unbeatable price for the quality. Communication was top-tier—Naree gave super detailed instructions on everything, including parking navigation and Turo policy guidelines regarding potential fees, so there were zero surprises. The pick-up location wasn't ideal, but given Turo's airport/location policies, it was managed as seamlessly as possible thanks to her clear directions. As a Tesla owner myself, I always prefer driving one when traveling for the comfort and familiarity, and having Full Self-Driving (FSD) included made getting around Orlando infinitely easier. I highly recommend Naree and Bandit. I will definitely be reaching out to book with her again next time I'm back in town. Thank you for everything, Naree!
